edgeAATolerance.reason: Measured on CI 39582857168 (issue #63, scale 125 captured at the right scale, 3 identical runs): maxInBand 100, over-32 pixels 515 of 4258 band pixels (12.1%), mean 6.4829, out-of-band 0 (placement exact, text-free). All difference is sub-pixel edge coverage, not geometry: Mac keeps fractional shape edges (a 30 pt circle at 1.25 is 37.5 px, partial column at 0.5 coverage; the 2 pt stroke is 2.5/3 px, two full pixels plus a partial pixel on BOTH sides) while the Windows host snaps shape frames and strokes to whole device pixels (37 px circle, partial pixel on one side only), so a band pixel differs by at most half a pixel of coverage (about 102 of 204 levels); Windows also blends stroke edge pixels with squared coverage (red edge R drops below 255), a separate renderer defect. Filled rectangles are exact. Tolerance = measured plus about 15%; PROVISIONAL until the Windows fractional-edge snapping is fixed.
